item.title: Waffling Between Hiring In-House vs. Clever Punch?
item.description: Trying to decide between hiring an in-house marketing director or working with a fractional team like Clever Punch? This blog breaks down the pros and cons of each option—no pressure, no pitch. Whether you’re a scrappy startup, a growing business, or ready to scale, we’ll help you explore the best path forward based on your stage, goals, and budget.

item.title: Client Case Study | Marketing for SinglePoint Builders
item.description: See how Clever Punch helped SinglePoint Builders refresh their brand, rebuild their website, and create a consistent marketing presence—from social media to photoshoots. A smart, flexible strategy keeps their business top of mind and aligned with their high standards.

item.title: Yes, We Use ChatGPT—Let’s Talk About It
item.description: We use ChatGPT—but with a human touch. At Clever Punch, AI helps us brainstorm, refine, and overcome creative blocks, not replace thoughtful marketing. In this behind-the-scenes post, we share our internal guidelines, real-world prompts, and lessons learned to show how we keep copy clear, custom, and client-focused.

item.title: Top 3 Marketing Strategies for Construction, Architects & Trades in Today’s Economy
item.description: Referrals slowing down? Don’t wait for the phone to ring. If you’re wondering how to keep referrals coming, how to stay on top, and how to fill your calendar with the right jobs — this is for you. Here’s our Top 3 marketing strategies that actually work for construction and design pros right now.

item.title: Why We’re Moving Away from Mailchimp for Email Campaigns
item.description: Sick of clunky email tools and rising costs? So were we. That’s why we’re moving to a sleeker, smarter platform. Here’s why Mailchimp no longer makes the cut, and how our newest email platform is helping us save time, money, and headaches. See what platform we’re switching to—and everything we are loving about it.

item.title: Protect Your Reputation: Build Google Reviews NOW Before that 1-Star Review Hits
item.description: Google Reviews are more than stars—they’re your digital reputation. From winning bids to boosting SEO, reviews can make or break trust before clients even call. One bad review? No problem if you’ve built up the good ones. Here’s why they matter—and how we make it easy.

item.title: Does Social Media Really Work? (Our Honest Answer: No)
item.description: Should you be on Instagram or TikTok? Is your social media helping market your business, or just draining your time? You might be surprised by our honest answer: for most construction, architecture, and trade professionals, social media doesn't drive real results. Let’s unpack why a marketing firm thinks social media doesn’t actually move the needle.

item.title: The Ultimate Guide to Thoughtful Corporate Gifting (with a Local Twist)
item.description: Looking to make your client gifts more meaningful? Corporate gifting is a chance to stand out, build connections, and reflect your brand. From handwritten cards to local and nationally available goods, here are our favorite ways to elevate your gift game and make a lasting impression with thoughtful, local, and creative ideas.

item.title: Clever Punch Wrapped – Our 2025 Year in Review!
item.description: From welcoming new clients and team members to launching creative campaigns across 20 cities and 11 industries, 2025 was full of growth, milestones, and meaningful work. We’re sharing the highlights, stats, and a few fun team moments that made this year unforgettable. See what made this year tick.

item.title: Why More Content Isn’t The Answer</span#x3E;
item.description: Posting more doesn’t guarantee better results. Without a clear strategy, excess content can dilute your message, drain resources, and stall growth. This piece breaks down why volume alone isn’t the answer, and what to focus on instead.
